h5_respawn_stone.design: one closed flat disc r.395, 0.206 thick (y.156-.362), no recess. Top faces zoned: ShroomGlow centre r.103 (24 tris), Moss sector 225-315 deg r.189-.395 (24 tris), Slate elsewhere incl. sides/bottom.
h5_respawn_stone.multi_material_note: Exported as ONE mesh with 3 material slots (Slate, ShroomGlow, Moss) and per-face material indices. A Roblox MeshPart import renders a single Material/Color per MeshPart: in Studio either keep it as one MeshPart (zones show only via a SurfaceAppearance/texture) or let the importer split by material slot, which yields 3 coplanar-adjacent pieces sharing edges (no overlap).
